content: वैद्य {%a.%} (-द्यी|{%f.%}) .²1 Relating to the Vedas, spiritual. .²2 Relating to medicine, medical. .{@-द्यः@} [विद्या अस्त्यस्य अण्] .²1 A learned man, scholar, doctor. .²2 A medical man, physician; वैद्ययत्नपरिभाविनं गदं न प्रदीप इव वायुमत्यगात् <ls>R. 19. 53</ls>; वैद्यानामातुरः श्रेयान् <ls>Subhāṣ.</ls> .²3 A man of the medical caste, supposed to be one of the mixed classes; (the offspring of a Brāhmaṇa by a Vaiśya woman). <ab>Cf.</ab> <ls>Mb. 13. 49. 9</ls>. .²4 A man of a lower mixed tribe (the offspring of a Śūdra father by Vaiśya mother).
